question: 单项选择：— Where is Tom? — He _____ to the library. A. has been  B. has gone  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"，问Tom在哪说明他不在这里。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (be) to Beijing three times.
answer: 答案：have been。解析：have been to"去过"，强调经历。

question: 单项选择：She _____ to Shanghai. She'll be back next week. A. has been  B. has gone  C. went  D. goes
answer: 答案：B. has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"。

question: 翻译句子：我去过长城。
answer: 答案：I have been to the Great Wall. 解析：have been to"去过"，表示经历。

question: 单项选择：My parents _____ to Paris. They will come back next month. A. have been  B. have gone  C. went  D. go
answer: 答案：B. have gone。解析：have gone to"去了还没回来"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He ______ (be) in this city for five years.
answer: 答案：has been。解析：for five years"五年"，has been in"在某地待了"。

question: 单项选择：— Have you _____ to America? — Yes, I went there last year. A. gone  B. been  C. come  D. went
answer: 答案：B. been。解析：have been to"去过"。Yes回答，last year说明是经历。

question: 翻译句子：她已经离开三天了。
answer: 答案：She has been away for three days. 解析：leave是瞬间动词，要转换为be away。for three days"三天了"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：My brother ______ (go) to London. He is studying there now.
answer: 答案：has gone。解析：has gone to"去了还没回来"。He is studying there now说明他现在在伦敦。

question: 单项选择：I have _____ this movie. It's boring. A. seen  B. saw  C. see  D. seeing
answer: 答案：A. seen。解析：现在完成时：have + 过去分词。see的过去分词是seen。
